python3 -s - <<'PY'
import ast, json
from pathlib import Path
paths=[]
for folder in ('common','board','host','tests/framework'):
    paths.extend(p for p in Path(folder).rglob('*.py') if '__pycache__' not in p.parts)
paths.extend(Path(p) for p in ('tools/aura_project.py','tools/aura_host.py','scripts/package_project.py'))
for p in paths:
    ast.parse(p.read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig'), filename=str(p))
configs=list(Path('config').glob('*.json'))+list(Path('data').glob('*.json'))+list(Path('hardware/platform').glob('*.json'))
for p in configs:
    json.loads(p.read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig'))
print(json.dumps({'python_files_parsed':len(paths),'json_files_parsed':len(configs),'passed':True}))
PY
